### Baruch Spinoza on understanding

Baruch Spinoza (1632–1677) approaches understanding within Rationalism. There is one substance—God or Nature—with infinite attributes; mind and body are parallel expressions, not interacting substances. Everything follows from divine necessity; freedom is understanding necessity, not uncaused will. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets understanding most directly—useful for searches such as “baruch spinoza quotes on understanding.”
